stories.title: Assessment Question Time-Box Validator with Cognitive Load Scorer
stories.description: Build CLI tool analyzing KT/KA questions for estimated completion time using readability metrics, complexity scoring, and Bloom's levels; flag questions exceeding time budgets per question type; integrate with CI/CD for quality gates.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/question_timebox_validator.py analyzes KT/KA markdown extracting all questions and calculating: (1) completion time using Flesch-Kincaid + question structure heuristics, (2) complexity score (word count, nested conditions, multi-part indicators), (3) Bloom's cognitive level (via keyword matching or inline comments); outputs report with columns: question_id | question_type | word_count | estimated_time_min | Bloom_level | status (OK/SLOW/COMPLEX)
Validation thresholds configurable per question type: MCQ ≤5min, matching ≤8min, short-answer ≤15min, scenario-based ≤20min; report flags questions exceeding thresholds and suggests splits/rewording
CI/CD integration: script fails if >20% of questions exceed time budgets (configurable threshold), enabling enforcement of assessment fairness standards
technicalNotes: File to create: scripts/question_timebox_validator.py (regex-based question extraction, Flesch-Kincaid readability calc, Bloom's detection, threshold comparison, report generation)
Test command: uv run python scripts/question_timebox_validator.py tuinalogy-services/C01/KT-01.md --output /tmp/timebox_report.txt && grep -c SLOW /tmp/timebox_report.txt

stories.title: Aesthetic Services Knowledge Assessment Item Analysis Report Generator
stories.description: Build Python script analyzing KA (Knowledge Assessment) question distributions across Aesthetic CUs; identify difficulty/Bloom's level imbalances, suggest rebalancing, and validate question-to-competency mappings for comprehensive coverage.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/aesthetic_kaa_analyzer.py parses all KA documents (C01-C04 per level): (1) extracts questions, (2) tags each with Bloom's level (via content keywords or metadata comments), (3) calculates difficulty distribution (word count, sentence complexity), (4) maps to CoCU competencies (via question ID or manual tagging in markdown comments), (5) generates report with columns: competency_id | num_questions | Bloom_distribution | difficulty_range | coverage_status

Report identifies coverage gaps: underrepresented competencies (<2 questions), Bloom's level skew (e.g., >50% at Remember level), missing question-competency mappings; includes rebalancing suggestions (e.g., 'C02 needs +2 Analyze-level questions; recommend splitting 2 current Knowledge questions into 3 Application questions')
Multiple output formats: markdown report for human review, CSV for instructor tracking, JSON for programmatic use; script integrates with CI/CD to flag coverage gaps
technicalNotes: File to create: scripts/aesthetic_kaa_analyzer.py (markdown parsing, Bloom's tagging via heuristics, competency extraction, distribution analysis, report generation; JSON output for tooling)
Test command: uv run python scripts/aesthetic_kaa_analyzer.py aesthetic-services/ --output /tmp/kaa_report.md && grep -c 'Coverage status\|Rebalancing' /tmp/kaa_report.md

stories.title: WIM Document Readability Enhancement Batch Tool with Flesch-Kincaid Scoring
stories.description: Develop batch processor scanning all .md WIM files across subjects (BEV, Aesthetic, IT, Tuinalogy); calculate readability scores (Flesch-Kincaid grade levels); identify overly complex paragraphs; suggest simplified alternatives while preserving technical accuracy.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/readability_analyzer.py analyzes all KP/KK/KT documents: (1) calculates Flesch-Kincaid grade level per paragraph, (2) flags paragraphs >grade 14 as 'Too Complex' with context, (3) generates ≥1 alternative rewordings preserving meaning and technical accuracy, (4) produces per-CU and per-subject readability report with summary metrics

Tool respects domain-specific complexity exceptions (e.g., allows higher grade levels for HV system technical descriptions if justified; includes flag explaining exception); baseline readability targets: KP ≤11th grade, KK ≤10th grade, KT ≤9th grade (configurable via CLI flag)

CI/CD integration: script generates warning (non-blocking) if >30% of paragraphs exceed target grade level; outputs markdown report with flagged paragraphs, alternative wordings, and overall readability metrics per subject; supports CSV export for tracking improvement over time
technicalNotes: File to create: scripts/readability_analyzer.py (Flesch-Kincaid grade calculation, paragraph parsing, alternative generation with semantic preservation, report generation)
Test command: uv run python scripts/readability_analyzer.py bev-diagnostic-rectification/C01/KP-01.md --target-grade 11 --output /tmp/readability_report.md && head -30 /tmp/readability_report.md
